$comment: Guardrail rules for check-dashboard-links.js. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes tested against each manage.auth0.com URL found outside fenced code. 'reject' fails CI. 'pendingDecision' warns until the blessed URL form is decided; then move the losing forms into 'reject' and delete the winner.

reject.message: Legacy Dashboard hash route; rewrite to the redesigned Dashboard URL (see scripts/data/dashboard-link-map.json)
URL-encoded brace in a Dashboard link; use a literal {placeholder}
Two hash routes in one Dashboard link
Losing competing new-form (/dashboard/*/); blessed form is /dashboard/#/
Tenant-specific Dashboard link leaks a tenant name; use the tenant-agnostic form
